statement: Several tracked companies show rapid funding rounds within 12-18 months, indicating active investor interest.
calculation: Funding round intervals computed from FUNDING.announcement_date; rapid interval defined as <=18 months.
limitations: Interval estimates approximate; does not distinguish planned vs actual close; sample is tracked universe only.
notes: INSIGHT derived only from FUNDING dates and amounts; no predictions; no unverified inferences.

statement: Same individuals (by person_id) are linked to multiple tracked startups; this suggests either co-founding or serial entrepreneurship in the dataset.
calculation: FOUNDERS.person_id frequency > 1 across companies; verified by matching names.
supporting_entities: P0018 (Rohit Bhagat, S0003+S0049), P0060 (Bhavish Aggarwal, S0013+S0050), etc.
limitations: Person matching relies on name strings, not external identity confirmation; previous-company details sparse (prev_companies ~0% populated).
notes: INSIGHT from FOUNDER_NETWORK; no claims of founder success; pattern observation only.

statement: Some companies have funding levels substantially above peer revenue levels within their primary sector, indicating possible high-investment/low-revenue growth profiles.
population: sectors with >=5 tracked companies (e.g., fintech, logistics, spacetech)
calculation: Sector-level median funding vs revenue comparison; outlier identification uses sector-level IQR + 1.5*IQR.
limitations: Sector size varies (N shown); outlier detection uses tracked universe only; no claim of causal funding efficiency.
notes: INSIGHT derived from OUTLIERS and SECTOR_ANALYSIS calculations; no arbitrary best-company ranking.

statement: Many companies carry preserved conflicts rather than resolved ones (467 preserved, 304 resolved, 3 unresolved), showing genuine data diversity rather than suppression.
population: all 368 tracked companies with conflict records
limitations: Preservation is by design (§19); does not indicate research quality failure; resolution depends on primary-source availability.
notes: INSIGHT from CONFLICTS audit; no fabricated resolutions; conflicts preserved per user brief §19.
